en: A stylized postcard featuring an illustrated medieval woman holding a basket, with another smaller medieval female figure depicted within the outline of her dress. The background is olive green with faint historic-looking script text. On the left, a large white letter 'M' appears above the printed name 'Mariken van Nieumeghen'. The overall design references a historic literary figure rather than a physical place.
